svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Checkpoint architecture
svg.desc: How a checkpoint reaches a check now: entry points call `osf verify`, which delegates to the checkpoint runner, which drives moon and reads the results back.
